columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|sensortrack: Stores a sensor track code, formatted as a number with 1 to 3 digits. Values are unique per record and may include integer or decimal representations.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|storetempc: Contains temperature readings between -90 and -60.1 degrees Celsius. Values are negative decimals or integers, typically formatted as -DD.D or -DD.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|temptolc: Holds the tolerance value for temperature, ranging from 2.0 to 5.0. All values are decimal numbers with one digit after the point, format D.D.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|tempnowc: Current temperature measurement ranging from -90 to -60 degrees Celsius. Common formats are -DD.D and -DD, with negative sign.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|tempdevcount: Counts how many temperature deviations occurred, values from 0 to 10. Stored as integers, mostly single or double digits.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|tempmaxc: Records the maximum observed temperature, between -60 and -40 degrees Celsius. Values are formatted as -DD.D with one decimal digit.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|tempminc: Records the minimum observed temperature, between -95 and -85 degrees Celsius. Values are formatted as -DD.D with one decimal digit.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|tempstabidx: Numeric index indicating temperature stability, ranging from 0.801 to 1. Values are decimals with 1 to 3 decimal places, sometimes whole number 1.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|humiditypct: Relative humidity measurement in percent, ranging from 10.0 to 30.0. Values appear as decimal numbers formatted DD.D.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|presskpa: Atmospheric or sensor pressure reading in kilopascals, roughly between 93 and 110. Values can be integers or decimals with lengths from 2 to 5 characters.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|shockflag: Flag indicating shock sensor condition, with values 'Triggered', 'Malfunction', or 'Normal'. Stored as text up to 20 characters.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|tiltflag: Flag indicating tilt sensor condition, with values 'Malfunction', 'Triggered', or 'Normal'. Stored as text up to 20 characters.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|impactflag: Flag indicating impact sensor condition, with values 'Normal', 'Triggered', or 'Malfunction'. Stored as text up to 20 characters.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|vibelvlmms: Vibration magnitude measurement, ranging from 0.02 to 9.99. Values are decimals with 1 to 2 digits after the point, formatted D.D, D.DD, or DD.D.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|lightlux: Light intensity measurement ranging from 0 to 998 lux. Stored as integer values of variable length, from single digit to four digits.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|acceldata: Numeric acceleration measurement, with values between 0 and 2. Values may be integers or decimals, commonly formatted D, D.D, or D.DD.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|handleevents: Count of handled events, with values from 0 to 20. Stored as integers, primarily one or two digits.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|critevents: Count of critical events, ranging from 0 to 5. Always stored as a single digit integer.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|alerts: Total number of alerts, ranging from 0 to 10. Stored as integers, single or double digit.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|alerttime: Date and time when an alert occurred, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Values span a short window between 2025-02-18 08:32:08 and 2025-02-19 08:32:08.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|alertkind: Category of the alert, such as 'Temperature', 'Security', 'Battery', 'GPS', or 'N/A'. Stored as text up to 50 characters.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|containlink: Unique container identifier, always six characters with format 'C' followed by five digits, e.g., C99982.
columns.vaccine_template|sensordata|vehsenseref: Unique vehicle sensor identifier, always five characters with format 'V' followed by four digits, e.g., V9998.
columns.vaccine_template|container|containregist: Registration code for container. 6 chars, pattern ADDDDD. Values C10354-C99982, all unique.
columns.vaccine_template|container|containmodel: Model name of container: Cryo Container, Ultra-Low Freezer, Thermal Shipper. 900 records split among three.
columns.vaccine_template|container|volliters: Numeric volume. Integer values, 2-3 digits. Common values around 77-495 liters.
columns.vaccine_template|container|masskg: Numeric mass. Values with 1 decimal or integer, 2-5 chars. Patterns DDD.D, DD.D, DDD, DD.
columns.vaccine_template|container|containflag: Status value: Active, Return, Delivered, In Transit. Four possible values, no nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|container|coolkind: Coolant kind: Dry Ice, Liquid Nitrogen, Phase Change Material. Three values, no nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|container|coolmass: Numeric coolant mass. Values with decimal or integer, 1-4 chars. Patterns DD.D, D.D, DD, D.
columns.vaccine_template|container|coolremainpct: Percentage of coolant left. Always 4 chars, pattern DD.D. Values between 20.0 and 99.9.
columns.vaccine_template|container|coolrefills: Integer count of refills. Values 0 through 5, single digit. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|container|refilllatest: Date of most recent refill. ISO format DDDD-DD-DD. Values from 2025-02-09 to 2025-02-19.
columns.vaccine_template|container|refillnext: Date of next refill. ISO format DDDD-DD-DD. Values from 2025-02-20 to 2025-02-24.
columns.vaccine_template|container|batterypct: Battery level as integer percentage. Values 0 to 99, 1-3 chars. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|container|pwrfeed: Power source: Battery, External, Hybrid. Three possible values, no nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|container|pwrbackupflag: Backup status: In Use, Available, Not Available. Three values, no nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|container|shipown: Owner identifier for shipment. 8 chars, pattern AADDDDDD, starts VS and 6 digits. All 900 unique.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|vehiclere: Text code 5 chars, pattern letter plus 4 digits. Unique per record, no nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|vehicleki: One of three values: Refrigerated Truck, Reefer Container, Cargo Aircraft. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|vehtempc: Numeric value, often decimal, format like -DD.D or -DD. Values cluster around -60 to -90. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|speedkm: Integer number, 1 to 3 digits. Samples include 0, 12, 63, 95, 116. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|distdonek: Decimal number, 4 to 6 chars, patterns like DDDD.D or DDD.D. Range about 1038.0 to 9988.0. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|distleftk: Decimal number, 3 to 6 chars, patterns like DDDD.D, DDD.D, D.D. Values vary widely. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|eta: Timestamp string, always 19 chars, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Range from 2025-02-19 09:32:08 to 2025-02-22 08:32:08. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|departsit: Text place name, 6 to 22 chars. Often two words like 'West Jennifer' or one word like 'Smithview'. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|currentsi: Text place name, 6 to 21 chars. Varied artificial city names. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|destsite: Text place name, 7 to 21 chars. Often prefixed by compass direction. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|gpsflag: One of three values: Active, Lost, Limited. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|latvalue: Signed decimal number, 6 to 10 chars, patterns like -DD.DDDDDD or DD.DDDDDD. All values unique. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|lonvalue: Signed decimal number, 7 to 11 chars, patterns like DDD.DDDDDD or -DD.DDDDDD. Values from about -0.11 to 179.99. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|altmeter: Numeric value, 3 to 6 chars, patterns like DDDD.D or DDDD. Range roughly 1019.9 to 9997.6. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|locupdate: Integer value, one of 5, 10, 15, 30. No nulls.
Timestamp string, always 19 chars, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Values all within 2025-02-19 08:02:08 to 08:32:08. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|transmode: One of four values: Air, Road, Sea, Rail. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|carrlabel: Text organization name, 7 to 33 chars. Examples: Johnson Ltd, Smith PLC, Zimmerman-Andrews. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|carrcert: One of three values: CEIV Pharma, ISO 9001, GDP. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|shiptrans: Code always 8 chars, pattern VS plus 6 digits. Unique per record. No nulls.
columns.vaccine_template|transportinfo|containtr: Code always 6 chars, pattern C plus 5 digits. Unique per record. No nulls.
